sample.chosen:
**Title: "Scott Frost and UCF's Perfect Season"**

**INT.** SPECTRUM STADIUM - DAY

The stadium is packed with UCF fans, a sea of black and gold. The UCF Knights, led by head coach SCOTT FROST, take the field for the 2017 season finale against the Auburn Tigers in the Peach Bowl.

**ANNOUNCER (V.O.)**
Welcome to the 2018 Peach Bowl! The UCF Knights, under Coach Scott Frost, are looking to cap off a perfect season against a tough Auburn team.

**CUT TO:**

**INT.** LOCKER ROOM - DAY

Scott Frost stands in front of his team, a calm but intense presence.

**SCOTT FROST**
(passionately)
Gentlemen, no one believed we could be here. No one thought we could go undefeated. But we did. Today, we show the world what UCF football is all about. Let’s go out there and finish what we started!

**CUT TO:**

**INT.** SPECTRUM STADIUM - DAY

The game kicks off, and it’s a battle. UCF’s high-powered offense, led by quarterback McKenzie Milton, trades blows with Auburn. The Knights’ defense makes crucial stops, embodying the resilience and determination instilled by Frost.

**ANNOUNCER (V.O.)**
UCF is putting on a show! Frost’s innovative offense has kept the Knights in the game, and now they’re driving for the win!

**CUT TO:**

**INT.** SIDELINE - DAY

With seconds left, Frost rallies his team for one final play. The Knights execute a perfect touchdown pass, securing the win.

**FINAL SCORE: UCF 34, AUBURN 27**

**CUT TO:**

**INT.** PRESS CONFERENCE - NIGHT

Scott Frost sits at the podium, a look of satisfaction on his face. Behind him, a banner reads “UCF: 13-0, Peach Bowl Champions.”

**SCOTT FROST**
(to reporters)
This season has been a dream come true. These players believed in each other and in our vision. To go from winless just a few years ago to undefeated is something I’ll never forget.

**FADE OUT:**

TO BE CONTINUED...

**THE END**

INT. MEMORIAL STADIUM - DAY

A sea of black and gold fills the stands as the UCF Golden Knights take the field. The crowd ROARS as SCOTT FROST, the head coach, leads his team onto the field. 

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Memorial Stadium for today's Peach Bowl game. The Golden Knights, led by head coach Scott Frost, are looking to continue their perfect season.

CUT TO:

INT. COACH'S OFFICE - EARLIER THAT DAY

Scott Frost sits at his desk, surrounded by game footage. He's intense, focused, and determined.

SCOTT FROST

This is the moment we've worked for. We've built something special here. But we have to stay focused, and we can't let up now. We have to keep pushing and keep improving.

CUT TO:

INT. LOCKER ROOM - DAY

The team is gathered around Scott Frost as he delivers a pre-game speech. Excitement fills the air.

SCOTT FROST
(passionately)
This is our house. This is our field. This is the culmination of everything we've fought for. Let's go out there and show the world what UCF football is all about!

CUT TO:

INT. FBC BANK STADIUM - DAY

The game is a nail-biter, with both teams trading touchdowns in the first half. The atmosphere intensifies during the second half and the Golden Knights take the lead. They emerge victorious.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
And that's the game! The Golden Knights won 34-27, and they've now capped off an undefeated year with this bowl win.

CUT TO:

INT. COACH'S OFFICE - NIGHT

(to himself)
We did it. But this isn't the end, it's just the beginning. 


FADE OUT:

TO BE CONTINUED...

THE END
